description: Named rotational camera-shake presets applied by battle damage (duration, blend times, pitch/yaw oscillation).

ID.simple: Camera shake preset name, e.g. NormalBlow_N.
ID.technical: FName row key. FStudioBattleSystem2E0::PlayCameraShakes iterates the ShakeIds arrays supplied by a Damage row (Id_CameraShake_Attacker / Id_CameraShake_Receiver), skips NAME_None, and finds the first row named Id in CameraShakeDataTables (+0x7B0). 48 exported rows including TEST and NormalStumble_*/NormalBlow_* variants.

OscillationDuration.technical: Float seconds copied to UGameCameraShake::OscillationDuration in the AddCameraShake initializer lambda (row +0x10 in the struct after Id). Export values include 0.2 s for TEST/NormalStumble/NormalBlow rows.

OscillationBlendInTime.technical: Float seconds copied to UGameCameraShake::OscillationBlendInTime. Export commonly 0.05 s.

OscillationBlendOutTime.technical: Float seconds copied to UGameCameraShake::OscillationBlendOutTime. Export is 0.05 for TEST and 0.1 for NormalStumble/NormalBlow rows.

RotOscillation_Pitch_Amplitude.technical: Float written verbatim to GameShake->RotOscillation.Pitch.Amplitude (row +0x24). Directional variants zero this field to make a yaw-only shake (e.g. NormalStumble_H); constructor default 0.0.

RotOscillation_Pitch_Frequency.technical: Float written verbatim to GameShake->RotOscillation.Pitch.Frequency; values in the export are commonly 60 (engine FOscillator frequency units).

RotOscillation_Yaw_Amplitude.technical: Float written verbatim to GameShake->RotOscillation.Yaw.Amplitude. Directional variants zero it for pitch-only shakes (e.g. NormalStumble_V); constructor default 0.0.

RotOscillation_Yaw_Frequency.technical: Float written verbatim to GameShake->RotOscillation.Yaw.Frequency (commonly 60 in the export).

notes: AGameCameraManager::PlayCameraShake (retail 0x105d9a0) requires a non-null row, a cached camera-shake modifier, Scale > 0 and bCameraShakeEnabled; battle calls pass Scale 1.0. The array index of the ShakeIds entry selects between UGameCameraShake_01 and UGameCameraShake_02 classes, so only two simultaneous shakes can be started from one Damage row.

The row fields are applied in an initializer delegate on the newly created shake; no roll oscillation, location oscillation or per-shake asset reference exists in this row struct or the 48 exported rows.

CameraShakeDataTables is manager slot +0x7B0; registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:426 and resolved at line 253. Only the damage system was found to look rows up in this table in the available source.

usages.detail: PlayCameraShakes resolves each Damage-row shake ID to a row over +0x7B0 and calls the camera manager with the row, ShakeIds index and scale 1.0 (retail 0x102b3a0).
PlayCameraShake transfers all seven numeric fields to the spawned UGameCameraShake and adds it through the cached modifier.
